top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

top_violation_types.title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not informed the parents of their right.

top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §747.303(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not notify Licensing of 2 positive COVID cases within the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the five enrolled children's admission information was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.501(a)(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational Policies did not discuss the procedures for vision and hearing screening.
